name: @3dverse/livelink-agent-samples
description: Runnable ingestion agents for @3dverse/livelink-agent, against infrastructure you start yourself
//: Deliberately NOT a root workspace. `node-opcua-client` pulls ~90 packages, and npm hoists a workspace's devDependencies to the root node_modules — where livelink.samples would then resolve it, follow the SDK's lazy import() into it, and drag the whole Node-only tree into a browser bundle. Kept here, it is installed on demand and reaches nothing else: `npm install` in this directory, once.
